limits: No physical EX/HX validation. DOSBox-X core is 8086_prefetch with 8088-sized queue, not physical CPU timing proof.
Known DOSBox-X mode 0Ah BIOS pixel-read mismatch remains: 96000/128000 mismatches, raw VRAM writes and guards pass. Independent GDI oracle does not use BIOS reads.
Current Windows GDI tests cover SRCCOPY/SRCINVERT and solid brushes, not all 256 ROPs or every hatch/pattern brush route.
GetDIBits with a NULL bits buffer is explicitly unsupported; real export/import/readback cases pass.
Text glyph shape is relational against a memory DDB. Raw VRAM cannot establish monitor colors; BIOS palette programming is statically reviewed.
No full app regression or complete native Windows-host OEM packaging verification performed here.
